$comment: What a customer distribution contains, as data (K12). The plan in docs/spec/WORKSPACE_HANDOFF_SIMPLIFICATION_PLAN_VI.md describes this as a table a person applies; a table a person applies is a table that goes stale the first time somebody adds a file. Every tracked path must match exactly one rule — an unmatched path fails the check, so a new file is a decision rather than an accident in whichever direction the default happened to point. This describes a surface; it does not create a customer repository, which is a separate act with its own review. `secret_shape_exemptions` names files whose credential-shaped content is deliberate — a test cannot prove a credential is redacted without containing one — and is data rather than an inline marker so adding one is reviewed.
